title: Dashboard layout configuration
description: Optional `layout` section of public/config.json. Omitting the section yields the documented defaults.

phoneOrder.description: Block order on phone after the clock/date header. Missing blocks are appended in default order; unknown and duplicate ids are ignored.

hiddenOnPhone.description: Blocks omitted from the phone layout. If this would hide every block, it is ignored.

hiddenOnTablet.description: Blocks omitted from the tablet layout. If this would hide every block, it is ignored.
